offering_description.value: Operates an online resale platform for secondhand women's and kids' apparel, shoes and accessories. Consumers send in used clothing and buy preowned items, while ThredUp processes, photographs, lists and ships items from its fulfillment centers. It also provides Resale-as-a-Service to retailers and brands.

primary_products.value: secondhand apparel; secondhand shoes and accessories; resale storefronts for brands

primary_services.value: consignment clothing processing and listing; resale-as-a-service for retailers and brands; order fulfillment and shipping

customer_segment.value: B2C: shoppers buying secondhand clothing and sellers consigning used clothing; B2B: retailers and brands using resale-as-a-service platform

revenue_model.value: product sales: consigned and purchased secondhand items sold to shoppers online; service fees: fees from retailers and brands for resale-as-a-service and processing; commissions or management fees: consignment payouts net of the company's share of sale price
revenue_model.category: product sales; service fees; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: retailer: takes in used clothing from sellers, sells to online shoppers; software / platform: resale technology and operations platform for retail and brand partners; asset operator: runs fulfillment and processing centers that inspect, photograph and ship items

geography_served.value: US national: US consumers primarily, some international shipping and European operations scaled back

specialization.value: related lines: consumer resale marketplace and B2B resale-as-a-service, both using shared processing infrastructure

distribution_channels.value: online: ThredUp website and mobile app; partners / resellers: retailer and brand partner resale storefronts

regulatory_exposure.value: low: general e-commerce, consumer protection, privacy and shipping rules apply

notes: Recent details on European operations and partner mix may be outdated.
